value.rationale: The finite 5-by-5 king complex is the natural square-board instance of recently studied strong-product independence complexes; its complete graded D4 action is not determined by known sphere-wedge homotopy results. Degree-five homology is the faithful two-dimensional irrep and degree-three axial versus diagonal reflection traces differ; these symmetry-sensitive distinctions are mathematically useful benchmarks and cannot be recovered from Betti numbers or homotopy type alone.
